title: joniris humilis
intro: Joniris humilis, commonly known as Yellow Passionflower or Passionflower, is a perennial vine native to the southeastern United States. It has been used in traditional medicine for its numerous health benefits, including its ability to reduce anxiety and insomnia, as well as alleviate symptoms of restlessness and seizures. The therapeutic actions of Joniris humilis include sedative, antispasmodic, and anti-anxiety effects, which are attributed to its bioactive constituents, such as flavonoids, alkaloids, and glycosides. These constituents, including harman and harmine, contribute to the plant's anxiolytic, anticonvulsant, and sedative properties, making it a popular herbal remedy for stress relief and sleep disorders.
